title: Climate crisis likely behind devastating Nepal-Tibet floods that killed more than 1,300
hook: Climate crisis likely behind devastating Nepal-Tibet floods that killed more than 1,300

beats.caption: Climate crisis likely behind devastating Nepal-Tibet floods that killed more than 1,300
If this holds, mountain safety changes forever.
beats.detail: A new study links climate to disasters.
beats.narration: If this finding holds, mountain safety changes forever. Here is the chain of events.

beats.caption: A massive glacier suddenly collapsed in August.
beats.narration: Last August, a massive glacier in Nepal and Tibet suddenly collapsed.

beats.caption: The resulting floods killed over 1,300 people.
beats.detail: Catastrophic damage in Nepal and Tibet.
beats.narration: The resulting floods were catastrophic, killing more than 1,300 people in the region.

beats.caption: Scientists say global heating weakened the ice.
beats.narration: Scientists found that global heating likely weakened the glacier, making it unstable before it failed.

beats.caption: This is the first study to confirm this.
beats.narration: This is the first scientific study to directly link the disaster to climate breakdown.

beats.caption: It proves that climate risks are immediate.
beats.detail: Not just a distant future problem.
beats.narration: It shows that climate risks are not just distant problems but immediate, deadly threats.
